name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 32/1
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: ‘Underlines the fact that dietary behaviours are shaped, among others, by food environments and structural factors; highlights the diverse barriers to healthy dietary choices, including their availability and affordability, which disproportionately affect low and middle income populations; calls for the Member States to ensure greater coherence between Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan and other public policies,’
